page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware allocation includes 32 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, 128.0 GB of system memory providing 4.0 GB per core, and no local storage. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The processor architecture supports instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, but lacks AVX512_VNNI and AMX capabilities.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by the stress-ng single-core score of 1108.19 and Geekbench single-core score of 945.0, both falling into the bottom 25% tier. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression also demonstrate poor throughput at 19.08 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 23515.32 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8272.0. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle tier, delivering 98.48 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 49.01 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance class is designed for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to overcome modest single-thread speeds. Factual benchmark results indicate average performance for database operations, static web serving at 13.89 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations at 22.12 million operations per second. It is also capable of handling moderate LLM inference tasks, processing 7B model prompts at 40.76 tokens per second. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it less suitable for high-speed local data caching or hardware-accelerated deep learning, positioning it as a stable, multi-threaded general-purpose compute node.
